people.name: Irileth
people.firstMeet: In Dragonsreach, the jarl's palace in Whiterun, at Jarl Balgruuf's side; she speaks to you there when you bring the jarl news of Helgen.

day.doing: standing near where she's placed; she has no daily schedule of her own

changes: If the jarl's court is exiled in the civil war, her one package sends her to the Blue Palace in Solitude, where she wanders the palace at any hour.
In Dragon Rising she leads the jarl's soldiers out to the Western Watchtower to fight the dragon.
people.role: the jarl's housecarl in Whiterun; quest giver

quests.how: a step in it: she has words for you in Dragonsreach while you're bringing the jarl news of the dragon at Helgen
gives it: she brings word of a dragon at the Western Watchtower and you meet her there with the jarl's soldiers

unsure.why: Only a class record id and an outfit id are in the extracts; neither resolves to a name, skills or a weapon, so I can't say how they fight.
She also fills aliases in Bleak Falls Barrow and Message to Whiterun, but the extracts don't show what she does in them; plus several unnamed quests, one of which (a housecarl alias) is from a mod.
With no package of her own while the court rules Whiterun, the records only say she stays where she's placed in Dragonsreach; quest packages may move her.

people.name: Farengar Secret-Fire
people.firstMeet: In his room in Dragonsreach, Whiterun. In the quest Bleak Falls Barrow the jarl sends you to him.
changes: Until you've first spoken to him, he keeps to one spot in Dragonsreach from 8 am to 8 pm (outside meals) instead of working at his lab.
people.role: the jarl's court wizard; merchant; quest giver

quests.how: gives it: asks you to bring him the Dragonstone from Bleak Falls Barrow, then takes it back from you
a step in it: has words for you in Dragonsreach while Odahviing is held there

unsure.why: He's a merchant with his own buy-and-sell list and his own merchant chest, open all hours, but the extracts don't list what's in them, so I can't say what he sells.
Only a class record id and an outfit id are in the extracts; neither resolves to a name, skills or a weapon, so I can't say how they fight.
He also fills aliases in Before the Storm, Dragon Rising and a few unnamed quests, but the extracts don't show his part in them.

people.name: Arngeir
people.firstMeet: High Hrothgar, the Greybeards' monastery on the slopes of the Throat of the World, when the Greybeards summon you in The Way of the Voice.

day.doing: walking in meditation by the fire
walking in meditation in the centre of the hall

changes: During one stage of The Way of the Voice he skips his 4 am outdoor walk and reads in the living area from 4 am to 8 am instead.
He hosts the peace council at High Hrothgar in Season Unending.
people.role: Greybeard; quest giver

quests.how: gives it: recognises you as Dragonborn and sets your Shout trials
gives it: names the Dragonrend Shout, can't teach it, and shows you the way up to Paarthurnax
a step in it: you ask him to host the peace council, and he does, at High Hrothgar
a step in it: optionally, you can ask him about the Elder Scroll
a step in it: one of the people the quest has you talk to

unsure.why: Only a class record id and an outfit id are in the extracts; neither resolves to a name, skills or a weapon, so I can't say how they fight.
The meditation walks are routes with no named spot in the extracts; where in High Hrothgar each one goes is read from the package names only.
He is also named in the quest Paarthurnax, but the extracts don't show what he does in it.

people.name: Malborn
people.firstMeet: The Winking Skeever in Solitude, during Diplomatic Immunity: Delphine sends you to meet him there. His own placed spot is inside the Thalmor Embassy.

day.doing: standing near where he's placed; no other package of his own

changes: Diplomatic Immunity moves him: you meet him at the Winking Skeever, then inside the Embassy at the party.
Diplomatic Immunity can also be started by storming the Thalmor Embassy instead of meeting Delphine in Riverwood; on that road you may not need him.
people.role: quest helper (Delphine's contact inside the Thalmor Embassy)

quests.how: a step in it: you meet him at the Winking Skeever and give him your gear to smuggle into the Embassy; at the party you talk to him and he helps you slip away

unsure.why: Only a class record id and an outfit id are in the extracts; neither resolves to a name, skills or a weapon, so I can't say how they fight.
He fills an alias in one more unnamed quest that may say where he goes after Diplomatic Immunity; the extracts don't show it.
His only package of his own is a shared noon-to-8 pm sleep near his placed spot; his whereabouts at the Winking Skeever come from the quest's journal, not a package.
The quest offers storming the Embassy, but the extracts don't show which of its steps (the Winking Skeever meeting, the party) that road skips.

people.name: Carriage Driver
people.firstMeet: Only in Diplomatic Immunity: he drives the carriage that takes you to the Thalmor Embassy party. The quest has you meet Delphine at the Solitude stables first.

day.where: his carriage (exact spot not given in the extracts)

changes: Diplomatic Immunity can also be started by storming the Thalmor Embassy instead of meeting Delphine; on that road you may never ride his carriage.
people.role: quest character: the driver who takes you to the Embassy party

quests.how: a step in it: drives you to the Thalmor Embassy for the party
